Part definitions and composition of context.system in the SysML model, read from Architecture.sysml; every folder view imports it.
Composition (diamond at owner, label = usage name)
Generated by tools/gen_safety_docs.py from safety/mil-std-882e/catalog.yaml. Planning view: not evidence of completed analysis, verification or risk acceptance.

g.text: Terms: BMS = battery management system · ESC = electronic speed controller (drives a UAV motor) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-A1-FC = PX4-based flight controller ·

SUS-A1-NAV = navigation sensors, camera and telemetry · SUS-A1-PROP = motors, ESCs and propellers · SUS-A1-PWR = UAV battery and power management · SUS-GSE = ground support, maintenance supports, charging and test equipment · SUS-I1 = integrated mechanized walker

and observation UAV · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager and PX4 command adapter · SUS-M1 = piloted walker · SUS-M1-CTL = mission, motion and balance control · SUS-M1-DCK = UAV dock, retention, charging and release · SUS-M1-MAN = manipulation arms and end effectors

· SUS-M1-PIL = pilot station, restraints, displays and controls · SUS-M1-PWR = power generation, storage, distribution and thermal control · SUS-M1-PWR-BAT = battery pack, BMS and contactors (alternative B) · SUS-M1-PWR-DIST = protected power distribution ·

SUS-M1-PWR-GEN = engine-generator and governor (alternative B) · SUS-M1-PWR-HPU = hydraulic power unit, accumulators and isolation (alternative A) · SUS-M1-SAF = independent safety monitor, protective stop and isolation · SUS-M1-WLK = chassis, legs, joint
actuators and stability sensing · SysML = Systems Modeling Language (SysML v2) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
